mainEntity.name: How do I choose between an AI digital product, newsletter, service, or affiliate offer?

acceptedAnswer.text:
If you have several possible business models, compare them using the same criteria before choosing one. Consider audience access, problem urgency, delivery complexity, startup cost, time to test, repeatability, and your ability to provide credible value.

Context: Run My AI Business discusses digital products, paid newsletters, memberships, affiliate marketing, websites, directories, and services. The resource library offers workflow examples across these models, but examples do not establish that every model will be profitable for every owner.

Key factors:
- Existing expertise and audience
- Customer acquisition path
- Delivery and support burden
- Evidence available within a small test

Practical guidance: Score each model, select one narrow experiment, and set a stop-or-continue decision date. Keep separate offers and audiences distinct so results from one project do not create confusion in another.

The business can help organize comparisons while leaving the final choice to the owner’s evidence and capacity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Compare audience access, urgency, delivery effort, startup cost, testing speed, repeatability, and your ability to provide credible value. Choose one narrow experiment with a decision date. Do not treat a library example as proof that every model will work for you.
